svg.title: Real Taylor polynomials and a complex radius
svg.desc: The function 1 divided by 1 plus x squared is smooth on the entire real axis. Its Taylor polynomials of degrees 2, 4, and 8 approximate it inside absolute x less than one but diverge outside that range. A second panel shows complex poles at plus i and minus i, each at distance one from zero, on the boundary of the convergence disk.

g.text: A real approximation limited by complex singularities
Each pole is one unit from the centre.
The Taylor series converges for |x| < 1; the real endpoints must also be checked.
